Kazuki, I couldn't change the address myself. The warehouse has already put a shipping label on your Power Kit box, so once that's done the address can't be edited from my side, and right now the whole order is still going to the old address.

I've sent the team your new (address hidden) address for the whole order. That covers the Harlo B30, which ships November 14, and they'll also try to stop or redirect the Power Kit box. The team is offline until Monday at 10am ET, and they'll email you at (email hidden) to confirm. You don't need to send anything again.
Thank you for your prompt assistance and for passing my new address to the team. I appreciate your help!
Used the chat-interview skill

You're welcome, Kazuki.

Before you go, one thing: what made you pick the Harlo B30 over the other miners you were weighing?

Thank you for asking! There are two main reasons:
1. It runs on a standard home outlet (100V), which is great since 240V requires extra electrical work in Japan.
2. I was looking for performance equal to or better than the Avalon Q's eco mode.

That helps a lot, thank you.

What made the Avalon Q's eco mode your benchmark, rather than just buying the Avalon Q itself?
Because I already operate an Avalon Q at home, and its eco mode offers a great balance of efficiency and lower heat/noise. I wanted something similar or better for my living space.

That makes sense. Low heat and noise matter a lot when it's in the room you live in.

One last one: are you thinking about adding anything next to the B30 and the Avalon Q, or is that the setup for now?

I am currently choosing between the Magic Miner 40T and the Harlo H15 Dual. 

However, instead of just aiming to heat the room, I'm also considering buying multiple solo miners under $500 to tinker with, so I'm still weighing my options.

Thank you, Kazuki, that's really useful to hear.

Whenever you want to compare the 40T and the H15 Dual, or look at the smaller solo miners, just ask. I'll pull the live prices and ship dates for Japan. The team will email you about the address change.
Thank you very much for your help today! Have a great weekend.

You're welcome, Kazuki. Have a great weekend too.

The team will confirm the Tokyo address by email, and your B30 ships November 14. Good luck with the move.
